items.q: What did the metal label teach him?
items.a: Hobby-passion is not a company. It did not answer **why he is here**, and Korea's metal **TAM was tiny**. Next business needed a bigger problem (healthcare: 6–7 of 10 sick) in a bigger market.

items.q: Why New York, not LA or SF?
items.a: Internationally friendly **and far from big Korean communities**. If it failed, settling into the diaspora would be easier in LA / Seattle / SF. He wanted compromise to be expensive. Arrived with no English, no friends, one silent week at home.

items.q: How long did it take to get Artem out of Google?
items.a: **Two years.** Met via a Princeton alumni dinner; clicked day one; talked until 4 a.m. Artem: Ukraine at 13, Princeton CS + theater, Maps geo-search lead. Jeong pitched healthcare as the Silicon Valley-shaped hole. Parents had to be convinced too.

items.q: What was the cute two-year mistake?
items.a: A Peloton-like smart bike, built first, pitched 2008–2009, **no PMF, no raise**. Today's rule: **test the idea before you build**. No money for more hardware forced Cardio Trainer (phone GPS + accelerometer).

items.q: Why sunset a #1 app with 5 million users?
items.a: Cardio Trainer hit #1 and **5M users in six months** (Kleiner seed). The mission was holistic health / weight, not just fitness. They killed the hit and rebuilt: 2014 AI-only Noom → May 2016 coaches + diet / exercise / stress / sleep.

Good = **amazing service**. Great = **lasts a century** with a trusted brand (*Good to Great*, Artem's pre-founding gift). Zero-to-one they did; **1-to-100** is the next hard journey. He is not a serial founder — **16 years** on Noom.

items.q: What is the immigrant-founder demon, and the wrong pose?
items.a: **Am I the right person?** Only he can answer. Managed by mission-why, the right people, early wake / exercise. **Strong fearless leader** is wrong — you are breakable; ask for help; admit gaps. At 3,000 people: delegate and sponsor better executives.

items.q: What does he say luck actually is?
items.a: Necessary — and it **only arises if you stick to one path long enough**. You make your own luck. Hypergrowth then looks like timing.
